nodes.label: GSAP Motion Policy
nodes.rationale: Motion uses transforms and opacity and must honor prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Reduced Motion Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Animations are cleared and smooth scrolling is disabled when reduced motion is requested.

nodes.label: Design Tooling Graph Noise
nodes.rationale: Tooling nodes distort the application runtime graph.

nodes.label: Runtime-First Graph Coverage
nodes.rationale: App composition, styling, CTA configuration, motion, and referenced assets have priority.

nodes.label: Deliberate Graph Boundaries
nodes.rationale: The graph excludes tooling, dependencies, build output, lockfiles, raw raster extraction, and unimported static references so it represents shipped runtime architecture.

nodes.label: React Compiler Disabled
nodes.rationale: The compiler is disabled because of its development and build performance impact.

nodes.label: Decision-Complete Scope
nodes.rationale: The useful target is complete architectural decision context, not a node for every file.
